title: Recall concerns and sale restrictions
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on early recalls creating worry about safety and, in one case, preventing lease payoff while recall resolution remains unclear.

negative.summary: The negative review complains that a nearly new vehicle already had multiple major recalls within very low mileage.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback combines strong recall-related safety concerns and non-recommendation with frustration that open recalls block lease payoff and lack a clear resolution timeline.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined review raises a question about whether it makes sense for the car to already have multiple recalls within a few months, without stating a clear overall evaluation.

limitations: This topic is based on only a few review fragments, so examples are limited.
The sample is stratified and not representative of all owners or all vehicles.
The mixed sentiment evidence comes from one review that bundles recall concerns, safety worries, and lease payoff restrictions together.
